---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  mutate(song = paste(track, artist, sep = " — ")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank))

top_songs <- billboard_long |>
  count(song, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 8) |>
  pull(song)

billboard_long |>
  filter(song %in% top_songs) |>
  ggplot(aes(week, rank, color = song, group = song)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "The long run",
    subtitle = "Weekly chart positions of the longest-running hits",
    x = "Week on the Billboard chart",
    y = "Chart position"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101820", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101820", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(color = "#F2F4F3"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#B8C2CC"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, color = "#F5C451"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#B8C2CC")
  )
```
